passages.text: Kestrova KS-200 and KS-400 sensors carry a 24-month limited warranty from the date of shipment. Replaceable sensing elements are covered for 12 months.
To request warranty service, submit an RMA request through the support portal. Replacement units ship within 5 business days after the RMA is approved.
Customer Support is available Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Central Time, and responds to support tickets within one business day.
The warranty does not cover damage caused by improper installation, use beyond the rated operating conditions, or unauthorized repairs.
